name: exceptioniq
description: Governed agentic investigation of finance reconciliation exceptions

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
